sourceStatus.basis: Bibliographic identity checked against indexed publisher/institutional records. No comprehensive correction/retraction check; inaccessible publisher pages and incomplete full-text rights remain unresolved.

checks.scope: Title, DOI, cited year and journal checked; authors transcribed only where available in inspected source. Full-text license and correction status not assessed.

rights.basis: Bibliographic facts and original scope note only. Full-text operations, raw retention, embeddings and figure reuse are unassessed and not performed.

records.metadataLocator: Publication heading, DOI and citation/issue metadata in indexed source; not linked recommendations or references.
